note: One lane per FTMO account. Each lane runs its own MT5 terminal, its own snapshot artifact and its own trader, and there is one publisher for all of them: scripts/publish-live-trading-lanes.js reads every lane's artifact and publishes them in one commit, so the page can never serve one account newer than another. `root` is the checkout the lane's cadence runs in ('.' is this checkout). The roots below are the intended VPS layout; they are the one line to edit when the lanes live somewhere else. `enabled: false` parks a lane whose terminal is not deployed yet: it is reported as disabled and skipped, so account 2 cannot stop account 1 from publishing, and flipping it to true (or deleting the line, since enabled is the default) is the whole second-account switch-on. No password, no investor login and no token belongs in this file.

lanes.label: FTMO account 1
lanes.terminal: C:\Program Files\FTMO Global Markets MT5 Terminal

lanes.label: FTMO account 2
lanes.terminal: C:\Program Files\FTMO Global Markets MT5 Terminal 2
